output.source_text: When moving from a sus chord to a regular dominant chord, add alterations (such as b9 or #5) to build harmonic tension before resolving to I. Moving C9(sus4) (C-Bb-D-F) to C7(b9) (C-Bb-Db-E) creates dual chromatic voice leading: D drops to Db and F drops to E.

note_vi: Bài 15 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 03:29-04:08. When moving from a sus chord to a regular dominant chord, add alterations (such as b9 or #5) to build harmonic tension before resolving to I. Moving C9(sus4) (C-Bb-D-F) to C7(b9) (C-Bb-Db-E) creates dual chromatic voice leading: D drops to Db and F drops to E. Nguồn giảng bằng tiếng Anh, câu trên giữ nguyên lời giảng.
